messages:
vireo_engineer_jay: Hey @maria_cs — Vireo Health here. We're evaluating a custom paraphraser that MUST redact PHI and live in our VPC/on-prem. Can CS kick off a Private onboarding + HSM integration? Pilot target: Apr 15 (tight). Also need PHI-focused evals: recall for identifiers, precision so we don't over-redact clinical terms.

maria_cs: Thanks Jay — noted. I'll create an intake and loop in SE & security. Can you paste a couple of representative inputs and the metric thresholds you're aiming for? Also: contract renewal is Apr 30, so timeline matters. :calendar:

onboarding-bot: Intake created: https://redwood.app/onboard/INT-4921 — assigned to maria_cs and sam_se.

sam_se: @vireo_engineer_jay thanks. We can do Private + HSM, but need dataset samples and target QPS and latency SLOs. For paraphrasing, typical tradeoffs: stronger redaction tends to reduce utility. Quick Qs: 1) Do you want deterministic redaction (mask everything matching PHI PII parsers) or model-based redaction with human review? 2) Expected token length distribution?

vireo_engineer_jay: Send samples — example below (sanitized):

```
Input: "Patient John L. Doe, MRN 12345, reported chest pain on 02/14/24. Prescribed 5mg lisinopril. Contact: 555-0102."
Expected paraphrase: "The patient reported chest pain and was prescribed an ACE inhibitor."
```

Target metrics: PHI recall >= 99% (identify/remove IDs/phones/dates/names), false positive rate <= 3% for clinical entities. Latency target for pilot: p95 <= 450ms for 512-token context. Throughput: 50 rps steady, spikes 200rps during business hours.

noah_security: @maria_cs @sam_se FYI: For HSM/KMS we need key wrap docs and a network diagram. Also confirm if audit logs must stay on-cust storage or can be forwarded to Redwood with retention controls. If PHI remains in any host outside customer VPC, we need a signed BAA.

maria_cs: Noted — I'll attach a checklist to the intake. @vireo_engineer_jay can you share required KMS provider (AWS KMS, Azure KeyVault, or HSM vendor)? Also, any SOC2 / ISO requirements from your side?

vireo_engineer_jay: We'll use AWS KMS + CloudHSM. Yes, SOC2 Type II and HITRUST baseline required. We'll DM certs.

sam_se: For evals, propose two tracks: automated safety evals (regex + NER-based PHI detectors) and human-in-the-loop spot checks. Suggest creating an eval harness with these metrics:

```
- PHI_recall = TP_PHIs_found / TP_PHIs_total
- Clinical_FP_rate = FP_clinical_entities / total_clinical_entities
- Semantic_preservation = BLEU/ROUGE + human rating >= 4/5
```

Can you provide 500-1k labeled samples for pilot? We can bootstrap synth samples but prefer real sanitized examples.

libby_pm: Heads-up product-side: we have a recommended paraphraser stack (13B distilled -> 7B quantized variant) that balances latency/cost. We can run a canary on Dedicated first, then cut to Private if perf and security checks pass. Will prepare recommended model variants and quant profiles for your workload.

vireo_engineer_jay: Canary on Dedicated ok as long as it's behind customer network and no PHI leaves our control during canary. Also need rollback plan and A/B for quality.

noah_security: Canary constraints: ensure VPC peering + no egress rules that allow S3 writes to Redwood-managed buckets. Audit logging must capture token-level request IDs. We'll validate in pen-test.

maria_cs: I'll book a 30-min intake call for tomorrow 11:00 PT. Agenda: sample drop, KMS details, eval metrics, pilot timeline, and renewal touchpoints. @libby_pm @noah_security @sam_se please confirm availability.

libby_pm: Confirmed. I'll bring model variant notes and cost estimates.

sam_se: Confirmed. I'll draft an eval template and share a small runner you can run locally: `python eval_runner.py --data samples.jsonl --metrics phi_recall,fp_rate,semantic`.

vireo_engineer_jay: Great — will DM samples and compliance docs after the call. One more ask: can Redwood provide a short SLA clause for PHI handling to add to our PO? That affects procurement.

maria_cs: We'll escalate SLA ask to legal; I'll include a preliminary clause in the intake doc and flag for expedited review.

onboarding-bot: Intake updated with attachments: compliance_certs.pdf, sample_manifest.csv (redacted).

maria_cs: Quick note on renewal risk — since contract renewal is Apr 30 and pilot start is Apr 15, we need at least two weeks of pilot telemetry to de-risk procurement. I'll put together a short runbook to maximize signal in that window.

vireo_engineer_jay: Understood — we'll prioritize labeled samples. Appreciated. :pray:

sam_se: Next steps summary (I'll paste into intake): 1) Vireo to share 500 labeled samples + KMS vendor + compliance certs. 2) Redwood to provide model variant recommendations, eval harness, and a canary plan (Dedicated -> Private). 3) Security to validate HSM/KMS flow and logging. 4) CS to coordinate SLA and renewal support.

maria_cs: Thanks all — will follow up with calendar invite and intake link. Closing thread until we have samples attached.
